stores the bounded allow-list of codegen styles phase 11 may consider

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: CodegenPlanDiscoveryStrategy

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: CodegenPlanDiscoveryStrategyBuilder

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: CodegenPlanDiscoverySystem

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: GeneralizedCodegenPlanDiscoveryStrategy

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: ManyOnlyCodegenPlanBuilder

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: ManyOnlyCodegenPlanVariant

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: ManyOnlyNoOverridesPlan

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: ManyOnlyOverridesPlan
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Planner-owned overrides payload for the many-only family.

keeps the many-only overrides lane separate from generalized plan payloads
owns cleanup of the many-only overrides planner payload

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellGeneralizedCodegenLanePlan

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellGeneralizedCodegenPlanBuilder

creates the planner-owned generalized lane-plan carrier for the selected lane variant

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellGeneralizedCodegenPlanCallMode
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Planner-owned call-mode labels for the generalized no-overrides fast path.

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellGeneralizedCodegenPlanStep
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Reusable generalized planner step object for one execution occurrence.

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellGeneralizedCodegenPlanTargetKind

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellGeneralizedCodegenPlanVariant

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellManyOnlyCodegenPlanBuilder

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellSoloCodegenPlanBuilder

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellCodegenPlan

stores planner provenance, plan-family selection, and candidate codegen style ids
lives on SpellCompilerArtifact as the generic phase-10 codegen output

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellCodegenPlanStrategy
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Abstract contract for one codegen-plan shaping strategy.

keeps planner strategy behavior separate from the top-level planner facade

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellCodegenPlanStrategyBuilder
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Registry holder for codegen-plan strategies.

loads the built-in solo, many-only, and generalized planner strategies
resolves deterministic ordered strategy tuples for planner chaining

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellCodegenPlanner
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Planner facade over artifact-owned model truth.

publishes the resulting SpellCodegenPlan back onto the compiler artifact

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellGeneralizedCodegenPlanStrategy

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SpellGeneralizedSoloCodegenPlanStrategy
